profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, that operates an online learning site at coursera.org. It trades under the ticker COUR and its SEC filings carry CIK 0001651562. The company describes its catalog as online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, offered with partners including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also sells Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site names a number of individual programs, including the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, the UI/UX Design Specialization, the Machine Learning Specialization, and the Deep Learning Specialization. Coursera describes these as job-aligned and built with employers and universities, and points learners toward fields such as AI, data science, cybersecurity, software engineering, project management, UX design, and business analysis. Its AI-related offerings include beginner courses in generative AI and programs from Anthropic and DeepLearning.AI.

Litigation records list 220 cases in California. No products or MCP servers are tracked for the company.
